# Welcome!
Welcome to this course on processes in porous materials! This set of pages serves as a bundle of all exercises we want you to make. Some of them we will cover during the lecture. Others you will have to do at home. Some will be straightforward, and some will require you to do some reading or searching.

*AI-statement*: it is not recommended to use AI. If you do use it to help you solve an exercise, we encourage you to make notes so you can study the information AI provided you afterwards. If you use AI to help you solve exercises, make sure to redo the exercises at a later time without AI to make sure you understood everything and are able to reproduce the result.

If you have any questions, please reach out to the lecturer of the corresponding topic.
